issues.title: Thumb handle detached from progress track
issues.description: In the Failure threshold slider, the handle position does not match the active filled bar.
issues.evidence: The filled track terminates at the 75% mark while the circular thumb handle is positioned near the 98% mark.
issues.suggestion: Align the thumb handle position with the active track width based on the current value.
issues.triageNote: Direct DOM measurement on /eval/pair-024 (dark, 1512x900): Failure threshold slider fill = 0→75.0%, thumb center = 74.5% (thumb spans 652–668px, fill end 664.5px is INSIDE the thumb); the ≤4px inward offset is Radix's built-in getThumbInBoundsOffset (keeps thumb inside track near edges) — standard upstream behavior. Auditor's 'thumb near 98%' claim contradicted by measurement; same alignment confirmed on pair-053/089/151 (all thumb centers within 0.8% of fill endpoints). No code change.
